body:
CHANGELOG updated in EmilyOS: Found and fixed a real boot-config gap by reading initramfs-rpi's own init script: Alpine's stock cmdline.txt has no root=, taking the diskless boot path instead of mounting the real ext4 root partition. build-pi-image-rootless.sh now writes a correct cmdline.txt; added missing root/fsck/localmount/swap/seedrng to sudo-queue/76's rc-update list. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
